notes.title: Coming soon from KENZsoft!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35197209/861d7a8715e513fb896ea1735f5a4569dfc6c0c6.jpg[/img]
Anime Expo has came and went, so of course we have something new to share with you! You're all looking forward to the next project from KENZsoft right? Well, so are we! The next project is called "[u][i]The Secret Atelier[/i][/u]" and we're bringing it to the west! It's currently still in development and we don't have an ETA for release at this time. You can follow the developer (@kenzsoft) on Twitter for updates on progress and of course we'll try to keep you updated as well! Like with Super Naughty Maid 2 we will be releasing this title uncensored/no mosaics! We'd love to share with you some samples (and trust us, they look great!), but you'll just have to wait a liiiiittle longer! Hang tight! 

[h1]Another 3D model game on the way![/h1]

We've teamed up with t japan to bring all three of their releases to the west officially! You may have heard of them before, but here's what they've created: SF - Glass - New Glass. We're going to start working on these very soon! Keep an eye out and look forward to it~ As for some other details: It will be in English and Chinese language and we're still confirming with the dev if the releases will be with or without mosaic. We plan to release the titles from t japan on Denpasoft first.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35197209/6efbf977393d17b8f837ef6195b383bf991f76bb.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35197209/55ec3b34b9fb60a72edcb9d0f4b56d81b0c5d733.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thanks for reading! Stay up to date with us by following our pages![/h1]

notes.title: Super Naughty Maid 2 Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/b811fe49c92eb35a5ca5f46ba40cd1bbfc8dde19.jpg[/img]
We hope you're all having a great Friday so far! We want to let you all know that [i]Super Naughty Maid 2[/i] is now available on Steam and on Denpasoft with a 10% discount until next Friday! The base version on Steam comes with mosaic, but we do offer a FREE UPGRADE DLC ON STEAM to remove mosaics. [b]This DLC is only available to users located outside of Japan.[/b] The version on Denpasoft is mosaic free by default, no need for any DLCs to upgrade your copy there! Happy fappin and all that~ 

We also are in the process of adding Steam trading cards to [i]Super Naughty Maid 2[/i]! Once they're approved we'll hit the live button and you'll start getting drops every two hours of play time. To see a sample of what's to come cards wise please check our announcement [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1097880/announcements/detail/1601508165503272052]here[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1083650/Super_Naughty_Maid/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1097880/Super_Naughty_Maid_2/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1105800/Super_Naughty_Maid_2__Uncensor_DLC/

That's all for now, we hope to bring you more lewd content you can look forward to soon! Thanks as always for supporting us and these awesome developers!
